statement: Installed ARM64 Cemu29f2f1f native Wiimote opens the owned UHID raw endpoint and exchanges status, EEPROM, register and input reports in four MP/MP+Nunchuk by holder/no-holder arms. No-holder Cemu writes A600F0=55 and A600FE=04; holder Cemu writes A400F0/A400FB while combined host output shows repeated kernel04/05 maps. Native requested modes are33 for MP-only and33/37 with Nunchuk; received37 packets are transport evidence, not decoded gyro. Every arm requests8 bytes at EEPROM0016 and receives error8 because the default caller EEPROM image is empty; no image was imported. Calibration succeeds in no arm and decoded application gyro is unobserved, so end-to-end gyro remains blocked without a protocol-defect or zero-gyro claim. The initial PATH/Flatpak-only availability lookup missed the installed non-PATH AppImage; its absence inference is superseded.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad840db277; Cemu29f2f1f ARM64 AppImage; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded native raw handshake observation with default empty caller EEPROM and reused virtual UHID. No calibrated rates, decoded-gyro acceptance, physical or radio promotion.
